title: Erasca, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Erasca, Inc. (ticker ERAS, Nasdaq Global Select Market) filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026, updating the timeline for its Phase 1 monotherapy data readout of ERAS-0015 (a pan-RAS molecular glue). The company narrowed guidance from "first half of 2026" to "no later than mid-May 2026." The data is being collected from two trials: AURORAS-1 (U.S., RAS-mutant solid tumors) and JYP0015M101 (China, conducted by licensee Guangzhou Joyo Pharmatech Co., Ltd.).
key_points: Erasca, Inc. is a Delaware biotech company (CIK: 1761918) listed on Nasdaq Global Select Market under ticker ERAS
The company narrowed the data readout timeline for ERAS-0015 to no later than mid-May 2026, from prior guidance of the first half of 2026
ERAS-0015 is a pan-RAS molecular glue being evaluated in Phase 1 trials for RAS-mutant solid tumors
The AURORAS-1 trial is being conducted by Erasca in the U.S.; the JYP0015M101 trial is being conducted by licensor Guangzhou Joyo Pharmatech Co., Ltd. in China
This is a company-specific clinical-stage biotech disclosure with no market structure or macro relevance
